name: RadioCard
purpose: Mutually exclusive rich option selection through native radio inputs and label items.
useWhen: A single-choice group needs rich passive option content.
composition: Compose a named Root with uniquely valued Items, each containing exactly one HiddenInput, Title and optional Description/Indicator.

rules.statement: HiddenInput is the sole input and focus owner. Item is a label. Preserve native label activation and do not add a second selection click handler.
Keep Item descendants passive; no nested actions, labels or extra controls. Item ref targets label; HiddenInput ref targets input.
Use controlled value/onValueChange or defaultValue. RootProvider accepts useRadioCard controller; controlled owners handle reset.
Match scalar orientation to group navigation and preserve RTL, disabled skipping and read-only focus without selection changes.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using a button as the rich item.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Item and one accessible native HiddenInput.

validation: Verify naming, one notification, forms/reset, keyboard/RTL, disabled/readOnly and refs.
